meta.scope: All 10 backend modules against 23 anti-patterns from REVIEW-2026-07-10-API-ANTIPATTERN

anti_patterns.name: No idempotency on mutating endpoints
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- Idempotency-Key header implemented on all mutating endpoints via shared/idempotency.py with 24h dedupe window
anti_patterns.root_cause: Original design omitted idempotency; added in Auth redesign (migration 019)

anti_patterns.name: Inconsistent error envelope
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- RequestValidationError handler in main.py normalizes to {"error":{"code":"VAL-001",...}}
anti_patterns.root_cause: FastAPI default {"detail":[...]} vs domain APIError mismatch

anti_patterns.name: Validation errors bypass error envelope
evidence: All routers use APIError for domain errors
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- unified envelope for both validation and domain errors
anti_patterns.root_cause: FastAPI default validation error format differed from APIError

anti_patterns.name: Wrong HTTP status on create (200 vs 201)
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- billing router explicitly uses 201

anti_patterns.name: No property-scope authorization (IDOR / cross-property data access)
evidence: backend/app/modules/billing/routers/billing_router.py:115-116 -- meter reading resolves room->property then checks
backend/app/modules/billing/routers/billing_router.py:182-183 -- history endpoint resolves room->property then checks
backend/app/modules/billing/routers/billing_router.py:275-280 -- list invoices scopes by property_id or user scopes
backend/app/modules/billing/routers/billing_router.py:331 -- invoice detail resolves property then checks
backend/app/modules/notification/services/notification_service.py:185-191 -- get_history() returns property-scoped data WITHOUT scope check
anti_patterns.status: PARTIALLY FIXED -- Auth module enforces on /invite; Property/Billing/Contract/Maintenance/Dashboard enforce on all endpoints; Notification module VULNERABLE
anti_patterns.root_cause: Notification service get_history() filters by property_id without verifying caller has scope; query param checked before user_id
critical_findings: Notification: GET /notifications/history?property_id=<victim> returns full history to ANY authenticated user (notification_service.py:187-188)
User property_scopes claim populated at login/refresh (auth_router.py:104, auth_service.py:_build_user_response)
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: HIGH -- Notification module is an active IDOR vector; 7 of 8 affected modules fixed

anti_patterns.name: Rate limiting is global and non-differentiated
evidence: backend/app/middleware/security.py:57 -- keyed only by client IP
backend/app/middleware/cors.py:32 -- expose_headers includes X-RateLimit-* but security.py middleware never sets them
anti_patterns.status: PARTIALLY FIXED -- /auth/login has dedicated 10 req/min limiter with headers; all other endpoints still use global 10k/60s without headers
anti_patterns.root_cause: Two separate limiters (global in security.py, login-specific in rate_limit.py); global never emits headers
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: Medium -- credential stuffing on /auth/register, /auth/invite, /auth/refresh not specifically rate-limited

anti_patterns.name: Weak input validation / schema not strict
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- strict schemas with extra='forbid'; enum validation on PaymentMethod; Literal on search_by

anti_patterns.name: Sensitive data in logs
evidence: backend/app/shared/audit.py:60-73 -- _SENSITIVE_KEYS frozenset includes password, token, id_card, card_number, bank_account, cvv, pin
backend/app/shared/audit.py:76-99 -- _sanitize_metadata strips these keys before audit log write
backend/app/middleware/logging.py -- NOT WIRED in main.py (see anti-pattern #17)
No request/response body logging middleware active
anti_patterns.status: AUDIT SANITIZATION PRESENT -- but LoggingMiddleware not registered so no structured request logs exist to leak
anti_patterns.root_cause: LoggingMiddleware defined in middleware/logging.py but never imported/registered in main.py
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: Low currently (no request logging), but if LoggingMiddleware enabled without review could leak

anti_patterns.name: No API versioning / deprecation mechanism
evidence: backend/app/config.py:APP_VERSION used in main.py:137 but not in API paths
All routes under /api/v1/ but no deprecation headers, no sunset policy
anti_patterns.status: ACKNOWLEDGED GAP -- documented in REVIEW-2026-07-10 section 8 as deliberate platform-wide gap

anti_patterns.name: CORS misconfiguration (wildcard + credentials)
evidence: backend/app/middleware/security.py:87-106 -- setup_cors_middleware() sets allow_origins=["*"] + allow_credentials=True when DEBUG=True
backend/app/middleware/cors.py:14-33 -- setup_cors_middleware() called again with explicit origins
backend/app/main.py:151 -- setup_cors_middleware(app, settings) passes Settings object as allowed_origins (type mismatch)
Result: TWO CORSMiddleware instances stacked; first allows * with credentials (invalid per spec)
anti_patterns.status: FIXED IN AUTH REDESIGN -- main.py now calls setup_cors_middleware ONCE with explicit allowlist; security.py no longer registers CORS
anti_patterns.root_cause: Double registration + wildcard+credentials combo in DEBUG mode

anti_patterns.name: Inconsistent response envelope / untyped dict responses
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- Dashboard OccupancyResponse typed; Notification uses NotificationListResponse wrapper

anti_patterns.name: Enum mismatch / invalid values accepted
evidence: backend/app/modules/billing/constants.py:37-44 -- PaymentMethod enum: bank_transfer, cash, promptpay, qr_code, credit_card
No "wallet" in enum; "promptpay" IS valid enum value
REVIEW-2026-07-10 section 5 claimed wallet accepted / promptpay rejected -- VERIFICATION: enum includes promptpay, not wallet; schema uses enum directly
anti_patterns.status: VERIFIED FIXED -- enum correct, schema uses enum; prior claim appears inaccurate

anti_patterns.name: Unbounded pagination / missing pagination
anti_patterns.status: MOSTLY FIXED -- Contract, Billing, Property, Tenant paginated with bounds; Maintenance /pending UNPAGINATED (returns all); Dashboard endpoints return single aggregate objects (appropriate)
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: Low -- Maintenance /pending could DoS with large datasets

anti_patterns.name: Missing security headers
evidence: backend/app/middleware/security.py:72-84 -- security_headers_middleware sets HSTS (non-DEBUG), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, CSP: default-src 'self'
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- security headers middleware active

anti_patterns.name: Sync/blocking I/O in async path / fail-silent returns 201 on failure
evidence: backend/app/modules/notification/services/notification_service.py:79-132 -- send_test() creates notification, calls _mock_external_send (async sleep 0.01), catches Exception, sets status=FAILED but RETURNS 201 with failed notification object
backend/app/modules/notification/routers/notification_router.py:33-48 -- POST /test returns 201 always, never surfaces send failure
No 202 Accepted + async pattern; synchronous in request path
anti_patterns.status: NOT FIXED -- Notification test endpoint is fail-silent by design but returns 201 on send failure; no async queue
anti_patterns.root_cause: SDD specifies fail-silent pattern but HTTP 201 on external send failure masks operational issues
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: High -- monitoring cannot detect send failures; synchronous external call blocks request

anti_patterns.name: Missing authentication on sensitive endpoints
evidence: All other routes require Authorization header via get_current_user dependency
AuthHeaderMiddleware only validates header format, defers token validation to deps.py
anti_patterns.status: VERIFIED SECURE -- all sensitive endpoints require valid JWT

anti_patterns.name: Observability middleware defined but not wired
evidence: backend/app/middleware/logging.py -- LoggingMiddleware class defined (sets X-Request-ID, structured logs)
REVIEW-2026-07-10 claimed not wired -- VERIFICATION: NOW WIRED in main.py:153
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- LoggingMiddleware registered in main.py:153; X-Request-ID on all responses

anti_patterns.name: Dead code / unused schema (Admin config PUT missing)
evidence: backend/app/modules/admin/services/admin_service.py -- update_config method exists but no route
anti_patterns.status: CONFIRMED -- UpdateSystemConfigRequest schema dead code; no write endpoint for admin config

anti_patterns.name: Timestamp precision / timezone issues
evidence: backend/app/modules/billing/routers/billing_router.py:174-176 -- read_date carries full created_at timestamp with UTC offset
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- billing timestamps include full precision + timezone

anti_patterns.name: Missing Cache-Control on sensitive endpoints
evidence: backend/app/modules/dashboard/routers/dashboard_router.py:56,80,108 -- Cache-Control: private, no-store on all 3 GETs
backend/app/modules/billing/routers/billing_router.py:179,272,320 -- Cache-Control: private, no-store on history, list, detail
backend/app/modules/contract/routers/contract_router.py:171,218,411 -- Cache-Control: private, no-store on active, detail, history
backend/app/modules/maintenance/routers/maintenance_router.py:157,188 -- Cache-Control: private, no-store on pending, detail
anti_patterns.status: FIXED -- all financial/PII endpoints emit Cache-Control: private, no-store

anti_patterns.name: SQL injection via raw query / string interpolation
evidence: All repositories use SQLAlchemy 2.0 async ORM (select(), where())
No raw SQL with string interpolation found in repository files
All UUID parameters typed as uuid.UUID, passed as bound parameters
anti_patterns.status: SECURE -- ORM-only, parameterized queries throughout

anti_patterns.name: Weak crypto / hardcoded keys / JWT issues
evidence: backend/app/shared/security.py:22-29 -- Argon2id via passlib CryptContext (time_cost, memory_cost, parallelism from settings)
backend/app/shared/security.py:57-85 -- JWT HS256 with SECRET_KEY from settings; jti + exp + iat claims; 15min access / 7d refresh (config)
backend/app/shared/security.py:108-117 -- verify_token decodes but NO revocation/rotation check (note says "planned for Phase 2")
backend/app/modules/auth/services/auth_service.py -- refresh token rotation implemented (new refresh token issued, old invalidated)
JWT algorithm hardcoded to HS256 (not RS256); secret key rotation not supported
anti_patterns.status: PARTIALLY ADDRESSED -- Argon2id correct; Fernet correct; JWT HS256 with rotation on refresh; NO token revocation list; NO RS256; secret key rotation not implemented
critical_findings: JWT uses symmetric HS256 -- compromise of SECRET_KEY allows token forgery for all users
No token revocation/blacklist -- logout only client-side; stolen access token valid until expiry (15min)
Refresh token rotation implemented (good) but no server-side revocation store check on access token
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: Medium -- 15min access token window limits blast radius; HS256 acceptable for single-service deployment but not for multi-service

anti_patterns.name: CORS double registration + wildcard+credentials
evidence: backend/app/main.py:151 -- setup_cors_middleware(app, settings) called ONCE with settings
backend/app/middleware/cors.py:14-33 -- setup_cors_middleware accepts allowed_origins: list[str] | None
main.py:151 passes settings (Pydantic Settings object) not list -- BUT cors.py:21 uses `allowed_origins or [...]` so settings object is truthy --> treated as allowlist --> likely empty/broken

VERIFICATION NEEDED: cors.py line 21 `origins = allowed_origins or [...]` -- if allowed_origins is Settings object (truthy), origins = Settings object --> CORSMiddleware receives Settings object as allow_origins --> TYPE ERROR at startup or runtime
anti_patterns.status: POTENTIAL REGRESSION -- main.py passes settings object to cors.py expecting list; cors.py treats truthy non-list as allowlist --> likely broken CORS in production
anti_patterns.root_cause: Auth redesign fixed double-registration but introduced type mismatch in cors.py call
anti_patterns.remaining_risk: High -- CORS may be misconfigured or broken; needs immediate verification

auth.status: MOSTLY FIXED -- idempotency, strict schemas, login rate limit, CORS fixed, logging wired, JWT HS256+rotation

property.status: FIXED -- property-scope on all endpoints, pagination bounded, Cache-Control set, idempotency on create

tenant.status: FIXED -- property-scope on search, strict Literal search_by, pagination bounded, Cache-Control set, idempotency N/A (no mutating endpoints in router)
critical_gaps: No idempotency on create tenant (tenant_router has no POST)

billing.status: FIXED -- property-scope on all endpoints (resolve-then-check pattern), enum correct, pagination bounded, timestamps precise, Cache-Control set, idempotency on 3 POSTs

contract.status: FIXED -- property-scope on all endpoints, pagination on active/history, Cache-Control set, idempotency on 3 POSTs

maintenance.status: MOSTLY FIXED -- property-scope on all endpoints, Cache-Control set, idempotency on create, BUT /pending UNPAGINATED

dashboard.status: FIXED -- property-scope on all 3 endpoints, typed OccupancyResponse, Cache-Control set, single-record responses appropriate

notification.status: CRITICAL -- property-scope NOT enforced on get_history (IDOR), fail-silent returns 201 on send failure, synchronous external call
critical_gaps: POST /test returns 201 even when send fails

admin.status: MOSTLY CLEAN -- role-gated (owner), CORS fixed, dead schema (UpdateSystemConfigRequest)

health.status: CLEAN -- hardcoded version only issue, intentionally public

top_5_critical_findings.title: Notification module IDOR -- any authenticated user can read any property's notification history
top_5_critical_findings.evidence: get_history() checks property_id BEFORE user_id; no scope verification
top_5_critical_findings.fix: Add _check_scope(current_user, db, property_id) in router before calling service; or move scope check into service.get_history()

top_5_critical_findings.title: CORS configuration regression -- settings object passed as allow_origins
top_5_critical_findings.evidence: setup_cors_middleware(app, settings) passes Settings object; cors.py treats truthy non-list as allowlist
top_5_critical_findings.impact: CORS may be broken (empty allowlist) or misconfigured in production
top_5_critical_findings.fix: Pass settings.CORS_ORIGINS (list) not settings object; add type guard in cors.py

top_5_critical_findings.title: JWT symmetric HS256 with no revocation -- stolen access tokens valid for 15min
top_5_critical_findings.evidence: decode_token uses HS256; verify_token has no revocation check; refresh rotates but access tokens not checked against blocklist
top_5_critical_findings.impact: Token theft = full account access for 15min; logout ineffective server-side
top_5_critical_findings.fix: Add Redis-based token blocklist checked in verify_token; or migrate to RS256 with JWKS

top_5_critical_findings.title: Notification POST /test returns 201 on send failure -- masks operational failures
top_5_critical_findings.evidence: Exception caught, status=FAILED set, but 201 returned with failed notification object
top_5_critical_findings.impact: Monitoring cannot detect send failures; synchronous external call blocks request
top_5_critical_findings.fix: Return 202 Accepted with notification ID; process send async via Celery; webhook/callback for status

top_5_critical_findings.title: Maintenance /pending endpoint unbounded -- potential DoS via large result sets
top_5_critical_findings.evidence: No page/limit params; returns all pending requests for property
top_5_critical_findings.impact: Large property with thousands of pending requests = memory/latency DoS
top_5_critical_findings.fix: Add page/limit query params with le=100 bound like other list endpoints

id_card_encryption.usage: encrypt_sensitive() / decrypt_sensitive() in security.py; tenant_service.py:100 encrypts before storage
id_card_encryption.status: SECURE -- proper authenticated encryption; key from env

jwt.claims: jti, exp, iat, user_id, email, property_scopes, is_owner, is_superuser
jwt.rotation: Implemented on refresh (new access + new refresh, old refresh invalidated)
jwt.status: PARTIAL -- rotation good; revocation missing; HS256 acceptable for single-service

property_scope_enforcement.gap: Notification module completely lacks property-scope enforcement

authz_audit.global_bypass: is_owner / is_superuser claims bypass scope checks (deps.py:62-71)
authz_audit.token_claims: property_scopes populated from user_property_scopes table at login/refresh (auth_service._build_user_response)

injection_audit.sql: No raw SQL string interpolation found; all repositories use SQLAlchemy 2.0 select().where() with bound parameters
injection_audit.xss: API-only backend; no HTML rendering; JSON responses only
injection_audit.command: No shell execution or user-input subprocess calls found

data_leakage_audit.audit_log_sanitization: Present -- _SENSITIVE_KEYS strips passwords, tokens, id_card, bank_account, etc. (audit.py:60-73)
data_leakage_audit.response_filtering: ID card never returned in tenant responses (encrypted in DB, not in schemas)
data_leakage_audit.cache_control: private, no-store on all financial/PII endpoints (anti-pattern #20 fixed)
data_leakage_audit.cors_expose_headers: X-RateLimit-* exposed but only login endpoint sets them (anti-pattern #6 partial)

immediate: Fix Notification IDOR: add property-scope check to /notifications/history
Fix CORS regression: pass settings.CORS_ORIGINS to setup_cors_middleware
short_term: Implement JWT access token revocation (Redis blocklist with TTL matching access token expiry)
Add dedicated rate limiters for /auth/register, /auth/invite, /auth/refresh (10 req/min/IP)
Convert Notification POST /test to 202 + async Celery task
long_term: Migrate JWT to RS256 with JWKS for multi-service readiness
Add API versioning/deprecation headers and policy
Implement secret key rotation for JWT and Fernet
